scenarios.name: doppler_run
scenarios.description: 120 s run at 2.68 m/s with Doppler speed + bearing; true distance 318.9 m

scenarios.name: position_only_run
scenarios.description: 120 s run with no Doppler (legacy track); true distance 318.9 m

scenarios.name: stationary_doppler
scenarios.description: 90 s standing still with jitter; Doppler ~0.15 m/s; expect ~0

scenarios.name: stationary_position_only
scenarios.description: 90 s standing still, no Doppler; expect ~0 (forward drifts, smoother's stop detection does not)

scenarios.name: stop_and_go
scenarios.description: red-light stop mid-run with Doppler

scenarios.name: gap_no_steps
scenarios.description: 30 s fix gap mid-run, no pedometer: gap not credited

scenarios.name: gap_with_steps
scenarios.description: stride learned over 80 s, then 40 s fix gap filled by steps x stride

scenarios.name: short_gap_with_steps
scenarios.description: 6 s fix gap: filter integrates it, buffered steps discarded

scenarios.name: trailing_gap_with_steps
scenarios.description: fixes stop 30 s before finish: steps committed at finish

scenarios.name: walker
scenarios.description: 1.3 m/s walk with Doppler

scenarios.name: sparse_15s
scenarios.description: fixes every 15 s (firmware power mode) with Doppler; expectedIntervalS 15 keeps them inside the gap window

scenarios.name: sparse_60s_position_only
scenarios.description: fixes every 60 s, no Doppler, expectedIntervalS 60

scenarios.name: sparse_without_interval_hint
scenarios.description: fixes every 15 s but expectedIntervalS left at 1: every fix re-anchors and credits nothing

scenarios.name: seeded_stride_gap_fill
scenarios.description: initialStrideM 0.95 carried over a pause: a gap 10 s after the start is filled before any stride is learned

scenarios.name: seeded_stride_out_of_range
scenarios.description: initialStrideM 3.0 is outside 0.4-2.5 m and ignored, so the early gap is not filled

scenarios.name: invalid_inputs
scenarios.description: non-monotonic t (ignored), speed>max and speedAcc>1.5 (Doppler ignored, fix kept), negative accuracy (floored), bad step count

scenarios.name: outlier_spikes_position_only
scenarios.description: v1.2 gate: three 35-45 m multipath spikes reported at ~4 m accuracy, no Doppler; the gate rejects them

scenarios.name: gate_lockout_jump
scenarios.description: v1.2 gate lock-out: the fixes jump 60 m sideways at t=50 and stay there; after 5 rejections the next fix re-anchors position

scenarios.name: doppler_bias
scenarios.description: v1.2 cross-check: Doppler reads 0.6 m/s high for the whole 420 s run; it is distrusted and the position path takes over

scenarios.name: optimistic_accuracy
scenarios.description: v1.2 adaptive R: fixes scatter with sigma 8 m but report 3 m, no Doppler; rScale rises above 1

scenarios.name: zupt_stop_with_steps
scenarios.description: v1.2 ZUPT: 40 s stop at t=60 with the pedometer reporting no new steps, no Doppler; distance stops after ZUPT_NO_STEP_S

scenarios.name: zupt_doppler_override
scenarios.description: v1.2 ZUPT: the pedometer stops counting at t=40 while Doppler says 2.7 m/s; Doppler overrides the ZUPT

scenarios.name: zupt_release_dead_pedometer
scenarios.description: v1.2 ZUPT release: the pedometer stops counting at t=40, no Doppler; after the filter moves ZUPT_RELEASE_M the ZUPT releases and the chord is credited

scenarios.name: legacy_stop_clustering
scenarios.description: v1.2 smoother: 60 s stop in a position-only track; post-hoc stop detection flags it in the smoothed figure

scenarios.name: low_speed_walk_doppler
scenarios.description: v1.2 debias: 0.8 m/s walk with honest 2-D Doppler noise (sigma 0.3); raw speed reads high, the debiased speed does not

scenarios.name: antimeridian_crossing
scenarios.description: v1.2 projection: eastward position-only run at -17 deg latitude across lng 180; the longitude difference wraps, so the crossing is an ordinary 2.7 m hop

scenarios.name: smoother_pace_change
scenarios.description: v1.2 smoother: position-only, alternating 2.0 and 4.0 m/s every 40 s; true distance 478 m

scenarios.name: doppler_scale_low
scenarios.description: v1.3 Doppler scale: Doppler reads 8% low for the whole 420 s run (an iPhone); the learned scale rises to about 1.07 and distance follows the fixes

scenarios.name: doppler_scale_high
scenarios.description: v1.3 Doppler scale: Doppler reads 10% high for the whole 420 s run (a fused-provider Android); the learned scale falls to about 0.93
